instruction:
You are a mechanical stormwater pump-station engineer checking a task-owned synthetic stormwater pump control and backup-energy package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Hazen-Williams hydraulic calculations, stormwater pump station controls, pump duty power workflows, and backup energy sizing shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-03-LH-03`
- Wet-well and pump schedule: `WETWELL-SSC03-003`
- Inflow event table: `INFLOW-SSC03-003`
- Rising-main profile: `RMAIN-SSC03-003`
- Controls load schedule: `CTRL-SSC03-003`
- Backup energy schedule: `ENERGY-SSC03-003`
- Flood-control memo: `MEMO-SSC03-003`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Pump capacity | {{ pump_capacity_l_s }} L/s |
| Pump count | {{ pump_count }} |
| Peak inflow | {{ inflow_peak_l_s }} L/s |
| Static head | {{ static_head_m }} m |
| Rising-main length | {{ rising_main_length_m }} m |
| Pipe internal diameter | {{ pipe_internal_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Hazen-Williams C | {{ hazen_williams_c }} |
| Pump efficiency | {{ pump_efficiency }} |
| Motor efficiency | {{ motor_efficiency }} |
| Fluid density | {{ fluid_density_kg_m3 }} kg/m3 |
| Control panel load | {{ control_panel_load_kw }} kW |
| Telemetry load | {{ telemetry_load_kw }} kW |
| Outage duration | {{ outage_duration_hr }} h |
| Usable battery energy | {{ usable_battery_energy_kwh }} kWh |
| Wet-well high water level | {{ wetwell_high_water_level_m }} m |
| Access level | {{ access_level_m }} m |
| Minimum wet-well freeboard | {{ minimum_wetwell_freeboard_m }} m |

## Checks

- Total pump capacity equals pump capacity times pump count.
- Hazen-Williams loss uses flow in m3/s and diameter in m.
- Hydraulic power equals `density x 9.81 x flow x total_dynamic_head / 1000`.
- Backup energy required equals control load times outage duration.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when pump capacity, backup energy, and wet-well freeboard checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated SWMM report-output evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "total_pump_capacity_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_capacity_margin_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "hazen_williams_loss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "total_dynamic_head_m": <numeric_value>,
  "rising_main_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "hydraulic_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "motor_input_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "control_load_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "wetwell_freeboard_m": <numeric_value>,
  "wetwell_freeboard_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the stormwater stormwater pump control and backup-energy template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic wet-well, pump, rising-main, controls, and energy source package.

[meta]
name = "stormwater-pump-station-control-backup-energy-package"
description = "stormwater stormwater pump capacity, rising-main, controls, and backup-energy metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound stormwater pump station metrics from a deterministic stormwater task-owned source pack. The template combines pump capacity, Hazen-Williams rising-main loss, hydraulic and motor power, control load, backup energy, wet-well freeboard, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "stormwater-pump-control"
standards = ["Hazen-Williams hydraulic calculations", "stormwater pump station controls", "pump duty power workflows", "backup energy sizing"]
tags = ["mechanical", "stormwater", "pump-station", "rising-main", "backup-energy", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.pump_capacity_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "WETWELL-SSC03-003 duty capacity per pump"
min = 72.0
max = 72.0

[params.pump_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "WETWELL-SSC03-003 duty pump count"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.inflow_peak_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "INFLOW-SSC03-003 peak inflow"
min = 118.0
max = 118.0

[params.static_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "RMAIN-SSC03-003 static head"
min = 8.5
max = 8.5

[params.rising_main_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "RMAIN-SSC03-003 rising-main length"
min = 420.0
max = 420.0

[params.pipe_internal_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "RMAIN-SSC03-003 rising-main internal diameter"
min = 250.0
max = 250.0

[params.hazen_williams_c]
type = "float"
description = "RMAIN-SSC03-003 Hazen-Williams coefficient"
min = 130.0
max = 130.0

[params.pump_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "WETWELL-SSC03-003 pump efficiency"
min = 0.78
max = 0.78

[params.motor_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "CTRL-SSC03-003 motor efficiency"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[params.fluid_density_kg_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/m3"
description = "INFLOW-SSC03-003 water density"
min = 998.0
max = 998.0

[params.control_panel_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "CTRL-SSC03-003 control panel load"
min = 1.8
max = 1.8

[params.telemetry_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "CTRL-SSC03-003 telemetry load"
min = 0.4
max = 0.4

[params.outage_duration_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "ENERGY-SSC03-003 outage duration"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.usable_battery_energy_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "ENERGY-SSC03-003 usable battery energy"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.wetwell_high_water_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "WETWELL-SSC03-003 wet-well high water level"
min = 14.2
max = 14.2

[params.access_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "WETWELL-SSC03-003 access level"
min = 15.05
max = 15.05

[params.minimum_wetwell_freeboard_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-003 minimum wet-well freeboard"
min = 0.45
max = 0.45

[outputs.total_pump_capacity_l_s]
description = "Duty pump capacity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_capacity_margin_l_s]
description = "Duty pump capacity minus peak inflow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hazen_williams_loss_m]
description = "Rising-main Hazen-Williams loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_dynamic_head_m]
description = "Static head plus rising-main loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.rising_main_velocity_m_s]
description = "Velocity in the rising main"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hydraulic_power_kw]
description = "Hydraulic pump power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.motor_input_power_kw]
description = "Motor input power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.control_load_kw]
description = "Control and telemetry load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_required_kwh]
description = "Backup energy required for the outage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable battery energy minus required backup energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.wetwell_freeboard_m]
description = "Access level minus high water level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.wetwell_freeboard_margin_m]
description = "Wet-well freeboard minus minimum freeboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for pump capacity, backup energy, and wet-well freeboard checks"
tolerance = 0.03
